rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Vaulted enables AI agents to share secrets—API keys, environment variables, .env files, and database credentials—via end-to-end encrypted links that self-destruct after a set number of views or a time period. Encryption uses AES-256-GCM and happens client-side; the server stores only ciphertext and the decryption key never reaches it. Integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and any MCP-compatible client.
